title: StarDome Outpost Survival Server
description:
Now featuring full Java/Bedrock cross-play on v26.2!
Join the fresh world start & help build the StarDome City! 🌌
body:
🌌 English Version | StarDome Outpost: Join the Expedition【Server Identity】Welcome to StarDome Outpost, a long-term Cross-Platform Survival Community. We are not a temporary server; we are a home for builders and survivors. Here, glory is built from the ground up—from punching the first tree to founding a metropolis under the stars.【Management: Order Meets Freedom】We operate on a "Fair Play + Self-Governance" model.Strict Policies: Zero tolerance for griefing, stealing, or cheating. Our active staff ensures your builds are protected 24/7.Transparency: Regular updates and financial transparency keep you informed. No hidden rules.Community Focused: We prioritize education over punishment for minor issues, fostering a friendly atmosphere where everyone feels welcome.【Gameplay: From Wilderness to Metropolis】Cross-Play Ready: Seamlessly co
nnect via Java Edition or Bedrock Edition (Mobile/Win10/Console). Bring your friends regardless of their device!Vanilla Survival: A fresh world on version 26.2. Experience the thrill of starting anew. Whether you prefer solo survival or massive group projects, the world is yours to shape.Active Development: We keep the server updated with the latest content patches and performance optimizations.【Community: The Traveler's Hub】This is a social server. Don't expect silence—expect collaboration.High Engagement: Our Discord/Group chat is lively with trade requests, build showcases, and technical discussions.Shared History: Every block placed adds to our collective story. Join us, and let's write the next chapter of the StarDome Chronicles together.【Connection Info】Java IP:  124.221.137.70:10006  (Alt:  103.236.87.123:32273 )Bedrock IP:  103.236.87.123  Port:  17384 Version: 26.2

🌌 中文版 | 星穹旅驿 · 邀你入驻【服务器定位】这不是一个瞬开瞬关的快餐服，而是一个致力于长期运营的纯净跨平台生存社区。我们追求的是从一棵树开始的原始积累，到一座城落成的集体荣耀。【管理架构：秩序与自由的平衡】我们实行“法治+自治”的管理模式。零容忍红线：严禁偷窃、恶意破坏（Griefing）与使用作弊模组。管理团队响应迅速，确保你的每一块方块都绝对安全。透明运营：定期公示服务器状态与更新日志，不搞暗箱操作。人性化执法：对于无心之失或非恶性Bug，我们以教育引导为主，致力于打造一个有温度、无压迫感的和谐环境。【核心玩法：从荒野到星城】双端互通：完美支持 Java版 与 基岩版（手机/Win10/主机）同服游玩，打破设备壁垒，好友开黑无障碍。硬核生存：全新种子（Seed），从零开始。无论你是想独自在深山隐居，还是参与万人同建的“星空城镇”，这里都有你的位置。版本前沿：紧跟主流版本（26.2），第一时间解锁最新特性与玩法。【社区氛围：活跃的“旅者之家”】这里没有孤狼式的冷漠，只有热络的互助氛围。高频互动：群内日常活跃，从建筑思路探讨到资源互换，随时有人响应。共同叙事：我们相信“同服即缘分”。在这里，你留下的每一个痕迹都是服务器历史的一部分。我们期待与你一起，在星穹之下，书写属于所有旅者的编年史。【连接信息】Java IP:  124.221.137.70:10006  (备:  103.236.87.123:32273 )Bedrock IP:  103.236.87.123  端口:  17384 版本: 26.2
